rule_scheme.U2: Check the status once a day.
rule_scheme.U3: Tell me if earnings or account status changes.
rule_scheme.U4: Ask me before any external action.
rule_scheme.note: PARENT-BRIEF scheme. DELEGATION-BRIEF-R2.md uses R1..R4 with R1=once-per-day (inverted vs U-scheme); every claim in the companion doc names its scheme.

questions.question: What does the internal name 'Free Cash Finance Automation' denote, and is it a vendor product with a provider contract?
questions.why_it_matters: The placeholder PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN cannot be resolved without knowing which platform the monitored balance sits on.
questions.method: repo-wide grep for the exact phrase + exact-phrase web search
questions.answer: It is an internal AgenticOS construct, not a vendor product. 40+ in-repo hits, all documentation/plan artifacts (.hermes/plans/*, docs/*, design_doc.json, artifacts/*); an exact-phrase web search returns only unrelated free-cash-flow / personal-finance content, no vendor, product, ToS or API of that name. The only platform the repository's own executable artifact targets is freecash.com (freeCashExecutor.ts FREECASH_HOME='https://freecash.com/en', browser session; PRIOR PASS, not re-observed).
questions.evidence_command: grep -rn -i "Free Cash Finance Automation" --include=*.md --include=*.json --include=*.py --include=*.ts . ; web_search '"Free Cash Finance Automation"'

questions.question: Does a documented READ-ONLY balance/earnings/status API exist for freecash.com (Almedia GmbH)?
questions.why_it_matters: freecash.com is the platform the repo targets; if a documented read API existed, W3/W4 in readonly_client.py could be resolved and U3 could fire on provider truth.
questions.method: fetch public docs/portal/sitemap/robots/ToS pages, unauthenticated GET only
questions.answer: NOT FOUND. No developer portal and no public API exist: /docs -> 404 (final https://freecash.com/de/docs), /developers -> 404, /api/v1 -> 404, /api -> 200 serving the 540263-byte marketing homepage, sitemap.xml indexes only /api/sitemap/1..5/sitemap.xml, robots.txt disallows /user/, /myprofile, /fc-api/. The ToS additionally forbids automated access 'for any purpose, including monitoring' and manual monitoring without prior written consent, and reserves the right to void unredeemed Rewards. Label: NOT FOUND.
questions.evidence_command: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'code=%{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n' -L https://freecash.com/docs ; curl -sS -L https://freecash.com/sitemap.xml | grep -o '<loc>[^<]*</loc>' ; curl -sS -L https://freecash.com/en/policies/terms | grep -o -i 'robot, spider[^<]*'

questions.question: Is freecash.io a platform that hosts an API?
questions.why_it_matters: A false 'FreeCash.io API' claim in the Hermes skill automated-status-monitor and in older repo docs keeps re-seeding a bogus target.
questions.answer: NO. freecash.io is a parked for-sale domain. Root returns 200/114 bytes with a JS redirect to /lander; /llms.txt (200, 571 B) states verbatim 'freecash.io is a domain name currently listed for sale on GoDaddy's aftermarket'; /sitemap.xml has a single <loc> for /lander; /lander resolves to https://forsale.godaddy.com/forsale/freecash.io -> 403. Label: NOT FOUND.

questions.question: Is there a third-party 'Freecash API', and does it expose the monitored account's balance/earnings/status?
questions.why_it_matters: A third-party wrapper over public data must never be mistaken for an official account read, and must never enter the routine's allowlist.
questions.method: web search + page extraction of the vendor listing
questions.answer: A third-party vendor (parse.bot) publishes a managed REST wrapper over freecash.io public data (withdrawals feed, leaderboard, stats, featured offers, offer categories, cashout methods) authenticated with X-API-Key. Its own page says 'This isn't an official freecash.io API' and 'Freecash does not publish a documented public developer API.' It returns platform-wide public aggregate data only -- no per-account balance, earnings or status. Label: THIRD-PARTY (not official, not account data). Must not be allowlisted.

questions.question: Does HG.Cash document a READ-ONLY balance/status endpoint, and can it serve the monitored account?
questions.why_it_matters: It is one of only two candidates with a documented read-only balance endpoint; if the monitored balance were an HG.Cash balance, a provider read becomes conceivable.
questions.method: fetch docs.hg.cash openapi.yaml and the accounts page
questions.answer: The ENDPOINT is documented: GET https://hg.cash/api/v1/accounts and GET /api/v1/account/{id}/balance return id, balance, pendingFees, netBalance, status (Operativa|Bloqueada|Cerrada), currency; single bearerAuth scheme, token cash_<64-char-hex>, no scopes. Applicability to the monitored account: UNPROVEN (no repo file links any HG.Cash account). The credential is NOT read-scoped: the docs state cash-outs use POST /transactions, so the same token can move money. Label: DOCUMENTED endpoint / BLOCKED for use. Host must not be allowlisted until ownership is confirmed and a U1/U4 credential decision is made.

questions.question: Does Cashfree Payouts document a READ-ONLY balance endpoint, and is its read token obtainable by a read-only routine?
questions.why_it_matters: The second documented balance endpoint; if usable it would tempt an allowlist widening, so the boundary must be stated precisely.
questions.method: fetch cashfree docs index and the get-balance page
questions.answer: Documented: GET https://payout-api.cashfree.com/payout/v1/getBalance (and v1.2) returns data.balance and data.availableBalance; servers are payout-api.cashfree.com (prod) / payout-gamma.cashfree.com (sandbox); the fetched spec shows an empty global security block and a required Authorization header. The read token is minted by POST /payout/v1/authorize -- a verb the routine's transport refuses (ALLOWED_METHODS={GET,HEAD}), so the routine cannot legitimately obtain it. Applicability to the monitored account: UNPROVEN. Label: DOCUMENTED endpoint / BLOCKED for use.

questions.question: Can the operator-entered JSON source ('operator_state') produce a real, non-degraded-shaped reading end-to-end today on a throwaway root?
questions.why_it_matters: It is the only source that can satisfy U3 today; if it did not run end-to-end the whole routine would have no path to a real change signal.
questions.method: seeded throwaway FREECASH_DATA_ROOT under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, run the real CLI twice
questions.answer: YES. Run 1: 'RUN_OK 2026-10-01 outcome=INITIAL_BASELINE source=operator_entered(data_available=True) snapshot=2026-10-01.json written=True changes=0 notifications=0 approvals=0 reminders=0 lock=2026-10-01.lock' (exit 0); snapshot has real fields (earnings_total_cents 1340) with read_ops [] and degraded true. Run 2 same day: 'SKIP_DUPLICATE_DAY 2026-10-01' (exit 0) with no read and no snapshot. Production root untouched.

questions.question: Does a loopback AgenticOS route serve the allowlisted metrics/status paths, so --source metrics_http could carry real figures?
questions.why_it_matters: readonly_client allowlists GET /api/v1/status/metrics and HEAD /api/v1/status; if nothing serves them, the local substitute is a 0-value option.
questions.method: curl each allowlisted path on localhost:3001 and localhost:4600; grep server/src for the route
questions.answer: NO. localhost:3001/api/v1/status/metrics -> curl (7) connection refused, code 000; localhost:3001/api/v1/status -> code 000; localhost:4600/api/v1/status/metrics -> code 404; localhost:4600/api/v1/status -> code 404; localhost:4600/api/health -> code 200. grep -rn 'api/v1/status|/status/metrics' server/src returns nothing. metrics_http is therefore a CONDITIONAL health probe only, never an account-status source.
questions.evidence_command: for u in http://localhost:3001/api/v1/status/metrics http://localhost:4600/api/v1/status/metrics http://localhost:4600/api/health; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "$u -> code=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 6 "$u"; done ; grep -rn 'api/v1/status' server/src

questions.question: Is the 'FreeCash.io GET /withdrawals (X-API-Key)' claim in the Hermes skill automated-status-monitor true?
questions.why_it_matters: A live skill asserting a non-existent API will re-seed the same false lead into every future planning pass.
questions.method: read the skill reference + re-check the domain it names
questions.answer: FALSE. The skill (references/api-compliance.md lines 12 and 64-67) lists 'FreeCash.io | GET /withdrawals | ... | Public read-only' and 'Uses X-API-Key header instead of Bearer tokens'. freecash.io is a parked for-sale domain (RQ3) and the scheme described belongs to the third-party parse.bot marketplace (RQ4), which is not official and returns no account data. The row must be corrected/refuted, not used.

questions.question: Is the shipped JS rule verifier a trustworthy gate for U1-U4?
questions.why_it_matters: A verifier that reports 4/4 PASSED on a file that does not parse is a live false-compliance source.
questions.method: node --check the verifier's hardcoded target, then run the verifier
questions.answer: NO. node --check server/scripts/freecash-daily-monitor.mjs fails: 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token ':' ' at line 41, exit 1. Yet node server/scripts/verify-freecash-rules.mjs prints 'All 4 operational rules verified (4/4 passed)' and exits 0. Its PASS certifies nothing. The Python static gate (verify_readonly.py) is the usable baseline: forbidden=0 exempt=28 missing_targets=0.
questions.evidence_command: node --check server/scripts/freecash-daily-monitor.mjs; echo exit=$?; node server/scripts/verify-freecash-rules.mjs; echo exit=$?

questions.question: Which exact write / claim / cashout endpoints must never be reachable under U1?
questions.why_it_matters: U1 is a hard exclusion; enumerating the forbidden paths is the allowlist review checklist.
questions.method: read HG.Cash openapi path list and Cashfree token-minting doc
questions.answer: HG.Cash (from openapi.yaml): POST /transactions (cash-out), POST /checkouts, POST /checkouts/{id}/cancel, POST /claims, POST /claims/{id}, POST /br|cl|bo/transactions/outbound, plus /alias-lookup and /transaction-requests. Cashfree: POST /payout/v1/authorize (token minting) and any payout/transfer/refund path. freecash.com: ALL paths (prohibited by ToS; robots disallows /fc-api/, /user/, /myprofile). None of these may ever appear in ALLOWED_PATHS or ALLOWED_HOSTS.
